package example

import (
	"errors"

	sieve "sieve.client"
)

type Client struct{ Calls int }

func (c *Client) Create(value int) (int, error) {
	invocationIDVar := sieve.NotifyLearnBeforeAnnotatedAPICall("example", "client.go", "*Client", "Create")    //sieve
	defer sieve.NotifyLearnAfterAnnotatedAPICall(invocationIDVar, "example", "client.go", "*Client", "Create") //sieve
	c.Calls++
	if value < 0 {
		return -1, errors.New("negative")
	}
	return value + 1, nil
}
